thread:
alex: FYI opened a small PR that touches auth proxy + how we load creds in private deploys: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/489

ajam: saw it, thanks. pinging security for review — does this change secret surface? @security

security: taking a look. quick Q: does this move any plaintext creds into configmaps or logs?

alex: no plaintext. change swaps a mounted secret -> in-memory decrypted file and updates the helm chart values to use the KMS-wrapped artifact instead of raw JSON. diff snippet:```yaml
# values.yaml
serviceAccountSecret: encrypted: true
secretArtifactKey: cmk-prod-auth-1
```

jess: timeline check — we were planning a canary at 18:00 PT. is this blocked on sec?

lina: dev testing passed, but the e2e on private cluster still needs a confirm that KMS policy allows the onprem node pool to unwrap.

security: two items: 1) verify KMS key policy grants only the service identity, not broad principal; 2) ensure rotated keys invalidates old artifacts gracefully. Also need a quick notes blob for audit.

jamal: for (1) the helm template uses the SA rolename: `svc-inference-canary` — we can scope the key to that.

security: perfect. for (2) add a metadata field `wrap_version` to the artifact so we can detect rewraps at boot. small suggestion:```json
{"wrap_version":"v1"}
```

alex: ok I can add wrap_version and a short paragraph for the audit log in the PR description.

jess: can we get one sec review + an acknowledgement from infra about the KMS policy by EOD? we need that before merging the canary.

lina: infra is out for lunch for 30m but i'll DM them and try to get a quick ACK.

security: I'm leaving a review comment about key scope and rotation plan. if you add the wrap_version and a brief runbook snippet (how to rewrap and rollback), I can approve.

alex: pushed another commit with wrap_version + runbook blurb. runbook commands (local):```bash
# rewrap artifact
kmswrap --key cmk-prod-auth-1 --in svc-creds.json --out svc-creds.enc
# validate on node (dry-run)
platformctl validate-secret --file svc-creds.enc --sa svc-inference-canary --dry-run
```

deploy-bot: merge-queue: PR #489 placed in hold until required reviews are complete (required: security, infra)

jess: thanks. pinging infra now. 

security: once infra ACKs key policy and the runbook looks good i'll drop the LGTM. :thumbsup:

lina: infra ACK (dm): key policy narrowed to `svc-inference-canary` and node pool IAM ok. they asked to add a one-liner about cron rewrap schedule — i'll add it.

security: saw the cron note, LGTM from security side. approved.

alex: thanks everyone — will wait for deploy-bot to clear the hold then proceed with canary.

jess: great, moving to canary window later today.
